content.user_title: Build Projects with Managed Development Context
content.value_statement: Scattered project knowledge creates inconsistent AI output and slows team decisions. This skill organizes product, technical, workflow, and delivery context into maintained project artifacts.
actual_capabilities: Defines roles and update triggers for product, product guidelines, technology stack, workflow, and track documents.
Guides greenfield and brownfield setup through a structured context, specification, planning, and implementation workflow.
Provides a validation checklist for product, technical, workflow, and active-track context.
Explains how to synchronize project documents when dependencies, features, practices, or track status change.
Supports session continuity with concrete starting, ending, and interruption procedures.
limitations: Assumes a Conductor-style artifact structure and slash commands that may not exist in every environment.
Provides guidance only; it does not create files, inspect repositories, or execute validation by itself.
Requires stakeholders to confirm product goals, standards, and whether existing context remains accurate.
Does not replace project-specific testing, security review, or expert architectural judgment.

use_cases.title: Establish a new project context
use_cases.description: Create a shared foundation for product goals, technology choices, team practices, and planned work before implementation begins.

use_cases.title: Document an existing codebase
use_cases.description: Extract current patterns into structured artifacts, then review differences between actual and desired practices.
use_cases.target_user: Developers adopting AI assistance in brownfield projects

use_cases.title: Improve team continuity
use_cases.description: Maintain track status, decisions, and session handoffs so contributors can resume work with consistent context.

prompt_templates.title: Create core context
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me define product.md, tech-stack.md, and workflow.md for [project]. Ask for missing goals, constraints, users, technologies, and quality requirements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Starting a new project with minimal documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Audit context freshness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [context documents] against [recent changes]. Identify stale statements, conflicts, missing decisions, and specific updates required before implementation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Checking project context before new work begins.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a feature track
prompt_templates.prompt: Using [product context], [technical context], and [workflow], draft a specification and phased plan for [feature]. Include acceptance criteria, dependencies, and validation.
prompt_templates.scenario: Turning maintained context into an actionable delivery plan.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile brownfield context
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [repository observations] and [existing context]. Separate confirmed patterns from assumptions, identify contradictions, and propose prioritized artifact updates with stakeholder questions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Aligning generated context with an established codebase.

output_examples.input: We added PostgreSQL and completed team invitations. Which context should change?
output: Update tech-stack.md with the PostgreSQL version, rationale, configuration, and operational constraints.
Update product.md to mark team invitations as implemented and record any scope changes.
Update the completed track and tracks.md with final status and completion details.

output_examples.input: Review this project before a new authentication track.
output_examples.output: The review flags an outdated dependency list, missing authentication acceptance criteria, and an unresolved deployment constraint. Implementation waits for stakeholder confirmation.

output_examples.input: Prepare a context handoff for the next development session.
output: Record completed tasks and the current stopping point in plan.md.
Document unresolved decisions, blockers, and required stakeholder responses.
Update tracks.md when the work status changed.

best_practices: Read current context artifacts before drafting specifications or implementation plans.
Update related documents together when product scope, dependencies, workflow rules, or track status changes.
Confirm extracted brownfield assumptions with stakeholders before treating them as canonical context.
anti_patterns: Do not scatter the same decision across multiple documents without a canonical source.
Do not let generated context replace repository evidence or stakeholder confirmation.
Do not expand context with details that do not influence decisions, behavior, or validation.

faq.question: What does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It guides creation and maintenance of product, communication, technology, workflow, and track context documents.

faq.question: Does it require Conductor?
faq.answer: The guidance uses Conductor concepts and commands. You can adapt the artifact model, but slash commands require a compatible environment.

faq.question: Can it analyze an existing repository?
faq.answer: It describes a brownfield process for extracting patterns. Repository access and analysis still depend on the active AI tool and permissions.

faq.question: When should context documents be updated?
faq.answer: Update them when product goals, dependencies, infrastructure, team practices, features, or track status change.

faq.question: How does it support multiple sessions?
faq.answer: It defines start, end, and interruption routines that record active work, decisions, blockers, and next steps.

faq.question: Does maintained context guarantee correct code?
faq.answer: No. Context improves alignment, but implementation still requires testing, environment validation, security review, and stakeholder approval.
